_comment: Live Polymarket-priced order-book seeding bot. `defaults` sets the risk profile per game phase; `markets` is the allowlist of games to seed. Start with ONE explicit game for a live test. Edits apply live (config re-read each tick).

live._comment: In-play: tighter exposure, wider spread, fast cadence. maxExposureUsd is the MOST USDC this ladder can spend on the game.

pre._comment: Pre-game / longer-term: more exposure, tighter to fair, slow cadence.
